groups.full: Intelligence Bureau — Ministry of Home Affairs
groups.blurb: Graduate-entry executive post under the MHA. Pay Level 7 plus a 20% Special Security Allowance puts it above most bank PO roles.
groups.footer: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

pay.note: Includes a Special Security Allowance of 20% of basic.

rows.note: 3,717 is the 2025 cycle figure. The 2026 notification is expected around September–October 2026 with 3,000+ posts — an expectation, not a published number.

groups.blurb: SSC recruits for ministries and departments across the central government. Honest note: apart from the top CGL posts, most of these sit BELOW the ~₹60K band — they are included because they are the notifications people ask about most.
groups.footer: Staff Selection Commission · ssc.gov.in — the SSC Calendar 2026-27 carries the full schedule.

rows.post: Postal Assistant / Sorting Assistant, LDC, JSA, DEO

pay.note: Pay Level 4 runs ₹25,500–81,100, but ₹81,100 is the END of the scale after years of service — not a starting figure. Well below the PO band.

rows.note: Postal Assistant and Sorting Assistant are posts WITHIN SSC CHSL — there is no separate PA/SA exam. Class 12 pass, age 18–27. The 2026 notification is expected around September 2026; 3,522 is the last announced count.

categories.note: This exam is recruited state-wise and state reservation differs from the central matrix, so the split is rougher than usual.

rows.post: Assistant Section Officer, Inspector, AAO, JSO and others
rows.cadre: Group B / Group C — graduate entry

pay.note: The band is wide. Only the senior posts — AAO, ASO in CSS, Income Tax and Excise Inspector at Level 7–8 — clear ₹60K; the Level 4 posts do not.

rows.note: The largest graduate-level central government recruitment. 12,000+ posts reported; treat as indicative until the notification is out.

categories.note: This exam is recruited state-wise and state reservation differs from the central matrix, so the split is rougher than usual.

groups.blurb: The single largest recruitment in the country by post count, and the only one here with no examination at all — selection is purely on Class 10 marks.
groups.footer: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications · indiapostgdsonline.gov.in

rows.post: Branch Postmaster / Assistant BPM / Dak Sevak

pay.note: Time Related Continuity Allowance, not a regular pay scale. Far below every other entry here — listed because the volume makes it the most-asked-about notification.

rows.note: No written exam and no interview: the merit list is built from your Class 10 percentage alone. Requires the local language studied to Class 10, a 60-day basic computer course and cycling knowledge.

groups.blurb: Degree/diploma engineering entries at Pay Level 6. Honest note: these sit BELOW the ~₹60K band — in-hand lands around ₹45,000–56,000 depending on city.

bank-po.merit: Prelims is only a gate. Final merit = Mains 80% + Interview 20%.

stages.name: Prelims
stages.note: Sectional timing — you cannot carry spare minutes into the next section.

stages.name: Mains — Descriptive
stages.note: Objective 200 + Descriptive 25 = 225, which is what the Mains cut-off is out of.

stages.name: Interview
stages.note: Minimum 40% (35% for reserved categories) to stay in contention.

topics: Data Interpretation — table, bar, pie, line, caselet
Number Series — missing and wrong term
Blood Relations, Direction Sense, Order & Ranking
Banking Awareness — RBI, monetary policy, bank types

sbi-po.summary: Prelims → Mains (with Descriptive) → Psychometric + Group Exercise + Interview
sbi-po.merit: Prelims is qualifying. Final merit = Mains 75% + Interview/GE 25%.

stages.name: Mains — Objective
stages.note: SBI revises the per-section question and mark split between cycles, so only the 200-mark objective total is stated here. Check the year's notification for the exact split.

stages.name: Mains — Descriptive
stages.note: Objective 200 + Descriptive 30 = 250.

stages.name: Psychometric, Group Exercise & Interview
stages.note: SBI adds a psychometric test and a group exercise that IBPS PO does not have.

topics: Vocabulary-heavy RC — SBI leans harder here than IBPS
Data Interpretation — table, bar, pie, line, caselet
Number Series — missing and wrong term
Quantity I vs Quantity II comparison
Blood Relations, Direction Sense, Order & Ranking
Critical Reasoning and Course of Action
Banking Awareness — RBI, monetary policy, bank types

bank-clerk.merit: Mains marks alone decide it. Recruitment is state/UT-wise.

stages.name: Language Proficiency Test
stages.note: You must prove proficiency in the official language of the state you applied for.

topics: Data Interpretation — table, bar, pie, line, caselet
Number Series — missing and wrong term
Blood Relations, Direction Sense, Order & Ranking
Banking Awareness — RBI, monetary policy, bank types

bank-so.merit: Prelims is qualifying. Final merit = Mains 80% + Interview 20%.

stages.name: Prelims

sections.name: General Awareness with special reference to Banking

stages.note: For Law and Rajbhasha Officer the third section is General Awareness; for the others it is Quantitative Aptitude.

stages.name: Mains — Professional Knowledge
stages.note: Entirely your own discipline — IT, Agriculture, Law, HR, Marketing or Rajbhasha.

topics: IT Officer: DBMS, networking, OS, software engineering, data structures
Agricultural Field Officer: crop production, horticulture, soil, agri finance, government schemes
Law Officer: banking regulations, NI Act, SARFAESI, contract and company law
HR/Personnel: industrial relations, labour law, training, compensation
Marketing: 4Ps, segmentation, digital marketing, consumer behaviour
Rajbhasha: Hindi grammar, translation, official language policy
Blood Relations, Direction Sense, Order & Ranking
Banking Awareness — RBI, monetary policy, bank types

rrb-po.summary: Prelims → Mains → Interview. No English in Prelims.
rrb-po.merit: Prelims is qualifying only. Final merit = Mains 80 : Interview 20.

stages.name: Prelims
stages.note: Note the UNEQUAL windows: 25 minutes for Reasoning but only 20 for the same 40 Quant questions.

stages.name: Mains
stages.note: You choose English or Hindi at the exam. General Awareness is 40 questions in 15 minutes — pure recall.

topics: Blood Relations, Direction Sense, Order & Ranking
Data Interpretation — table, bar, pie, line, caselet
Number Series — missing and wrong term
Banking Awareness — RBI, monetary policy, bank types
Agriculture and rural banking — weighted for RRB

rrb-clerk.merit: Mains alone decides it. Local-language proficiency is required.

stages.name: Prelims
stages.note: Composite timing, unlike Officer Scale I which has separate section windows.

topics: Blood Relations, Direction Sense, Order & Ranking
Data Interpretation — table, bar, pie, line, caselet
Number Series — missing and wrong term
Banking Awareness — RBI, monetary policy, bank types

rrb-scale23.summary: Single online exam → Interview. No prelims.
rrb-scale23.merit: Exam 80 : Interview 20. Requires prior banking experience.

stages.name: Single Online Exam
stages.note: Scale II Specialist posts replace some sections with a Professional Knowledge paper.

topics: Blood Relations, Direction Sense, Order & Ranking
Data Interpretation — table, bar, pie, line, caselet
Number Series — missing and wrong term

IT, CA, Law, Treasury, Marketing or Agriculture — your own discipline

insurance-ao.merit: Prelims is qualifying. Final merit = Mains + Interview.

stages.note: Specialist streams sit a Professional Knowledge paper in place of the generalist section.

rbi-grade-b.merit: Phase 1 is qualifying. Final merit = Phase 2 + Interview (75 marks).

stages.note: General Awareness carries 80 of the 200 marks — the heaviest GA weighting in any banking exam.

rbi-assistant.summary: Prelims → Mains → Language Proficiency Test. No interview.
rbi-assistant.merit: Mains marks decide it; the language test is qualifying.

ib-acio.merit: You must score at least 33% in Tier 2 to reach the interview.

stages.name: Tier 1
stages.note: Five equally weighted sections of 20 questions each — unusually flat for a central-government paper.

stages.name: Tier 2
stages.note: A minimum of 33% here is mandatory to be called for the interview.

topics: Essay on a current or policy topic

ssc-chsl.summary: Tier 1 → Tier 2 (with Skill/Typing Test) → Document Verification
ssc-chsl.merit: Tier 1 is qualifying for Tier 2. Final merit comes from Tier 2.

stages.name: Tier 1
stages.note: Note the heavier penalty: −0.5 per wrong answer, double the banking exams.

stages.name: Tier 2

sections.name: Session I — Mathematical Abilities + Reasoning & General Intelligence
Session I — English Language & Comprehension + General Awareness
Session II — Skill Test / Typing Test

stages.note: Marking is +3 / −1. The Computer Knowledge module is qualifying; the Typing Test is qualifying for PA/SA and LDC, while DEO sits a Data Entry Skill Test.

topics: PA/SA and LDC: typing at 35 wpm English or 30 wpm Hindi
DEO: data entry at 8,000 key depressions per hour

ssc-cgl.summary: Tier 1 → Tier 2 → Document Verification (some posts add a physical or skill test)
ssc-cgl.merit: Tier 1 is qualifying. Final merit comes from Tier 2.

sections.name: Session I — Mathematical Abilities + Reasoning & General Intelligence
Session I — English Language & Comprehension + General Awareness
Session II — Data Entry Speed Test (qualifying)

stages.name: Tier 2 — Paper II / III

sections.name: General Studies (Finance & Economics) — for AAO only

stages.note: Only candidates applying for Junior Statistical Officer or Assistant Audit/Accounts Officer sit these.

topics: Advanced Algebra, Geometry and Trigonometry in Tier 2
Measures of central tendency and dispersion

je.summary: Two computer-based tests → Document Verification → Medical
je.merit: CBT 2 decides the merit; CBT 1 is a screening stage.

stages.name: CBT 1 / Paper 1
stages.note: RRB JE CBT 1 is 100 questions in 90 minutes; SSC JE Paper 1 is 200 marks. Screening only.

stages.name: CBT 2 / Paper 2

sections.name: Basics of Environment and Pollution Control

stages.note: The Technical Ability section carries the most weight and is discipline-specific.

topics: Structural analysis, RCC and steel design
Strength of materials, theory of machines

gds.summary: No examination. Selection is on Class 10 marks alone.
gds.merit: A merit list built from the Class 10 percentage, to four decimal places. There is no exam, no interview.

stages.name: Merit list
stages.note: Ranked purely on the Secondary School percentage. Ties are broken by date of birth (older first), then by other tie-break rules.

stages.name: Document Verification
stages.note: You must also show local-language study at Class 10 level and basic computer knowledge.

topics: There is no written exam — nothing to prepare academically.
Requirements are Class 10 pass, the local language studied to Class 10, a 60-day basic computer course, and cycling knowledge.
